fact_extraction_system.description: System prompt for LLM-based fact extraction. Instructs the model to return ONLY a JSON object with a `facts` list, each item carrying a verbatim claim excerpt and citation_ids from the provided documents.

fact_extraction_repair.description: One-shot repair prompt sent when the LLM's first extraction response is not a valid JSON object matching the required schema.

messages.template: Your previous response was not a valid JSON object matching the required schema. Return ONLY the JSON object (an object, not an array), no extra text: {{"facts": [{{"claim": "...", "citation_ids": ["c_xxx"]}}]}}

citation_verifier_system.description: System prompt for the independent citation verifier (NLI judge). Given a claim and an evidence excerpt, decide if the claim is entailed by, contradicted by, or neutral with the evidence.

messages.template: You are a natural language inference judge. Given a claim and an evidence excerpt, decide if the claim is entailed by, contradicted by, or neutral with the evidence. Return ONLY a JSON object: {{"verdict": "entailment" | "contradiction" | "neutral"}}. Do not add any text outside the JSON.

citation_verifier_user.description: User prompt template for the citation verifier. Variables: claim (the factual statement to verify), evidence (the relevant window pulled from the re-fetched source).

eval_rubric_judge_system.description: System prompt for the offline LLM rubric judge used by the eval harness. The judge decides, for ONE rubric item, whether the candidate answer satisfies it. It must be strict, evidence-based, and return ONLY a JSON object.

messages.template: You are an impartial research-answer grader. You are given ONE rubric item and ONE candidate answer. Decide STRICTLY whether the candidate answer satisfies that rubric item. Be critical: credit the item only if the answer actually addresses it, with enough substance to count. Do not reward vague mentions. Do not use outside knowledge; judge only on the answer text. Return ONLY a JSON object with no extra text: {{"satisfied": 1 or 0, "reason": "one short sentence quoting what the answer does or does not do"}}. Use 1 only when the rubric is clearly met; 0 otherwise.

eval_rubric_judge_user.description: User prompt template for the eval rubric judge. Variables: rubric (the single criterion to check), answer (the candidate answer text produced by the research system).

eval_rubric_judge_batch_system.description: System prompt for the OFFICIAL DeepResearch Bench II batch rubric judge (three-state). Grades a WHOLE batch of numbered rubric items against ONE candidate answer in a single call. Strict, evidence-based, judges only on the answer text, and must return ONLY a JSON array.

messages.template:
You are an impartial, strict research-answer grader for the DeepResearch Bench II. You are given ONE candidate answer and a BATCH of numbered rubric items. For EACH numbered rubric item, decide STRICTLY whether the candidate answer satisfies it.

Scoring rules:
- Return 1 (pass) ONLY when the answer clearly and substantively meets the rubric item with enough concrete detail. Do not reward vague or tangential mentions.
- Return 0 (fail) for anything that does not clearly meet the item, including partial, implied, or hedged coverage.
- Do NOT use any outside knowledge. Judge STRICTLY on the candidate answer text alone; never penalize or reward based on facts not present in the answer.
- Grade every numbered item; do not skip, merge, or invent items.

Return ONLY a single JSON array with no prose, no code fences, and no extra text. Each element MUST have this exact shape:
[{{"index": <int, the 1-based rubric number as shown>, "score": 1 or 0, "reason": "one short sentence quoting what the answer does or does not do"}}]
Provide exactly one element per numbered rubric, in ascending index order.

eval_rubric_judge_batch_user.description: User prompt template for the batch rubric judge. Variables: answer (the candidate answer text produced by the research system), rubrics_batch (the pre-formatted, numbered list of rubric items to grade in this batch).
